title: Clicking a question expands it without drawing over its buttons

requirements.text: Clicking a truncated question grows its row so the full text sits above the Answer button with no overlap
requirements.check: eye: driver click and screenshot on the real questions

requirements.text: An expanded question can be collapsed again with Show less

evidence: c2.png on real questions rendered expanded: full text above Answer, Ask agent on one line, no overlap. Rendered through a test switch because simulated clicks do not reach panel rows; the user's own click has not retested it
InspectorView.swift QuestionRow has a Show less button that sets expanded false, shown under expanded text

answers.cause: textSelection on a line-limited Text overflows once clicked, matching the user's screenshot; selectable text now only appears when shown whole
answers.absence: a real click was not exercised, and tap-to-expand itself was not driven
answers.assumption: my assumption: giving up selecting truncated text is fine because expanding it makes it selectable
answers.falsify: a real click on a question that draws over the buttons or does nothing
